digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify routing and documentation-gate aggregation
propositions: Documentation-only patchsets must select a reduced docs-only Verify lane that runs only documentation gates and skips the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs.

The routing decision (classifier job) must execute only from trusted origin/main with no untrusted patchset logic; the exact changeset is HEAD^..HEAD; classifier failure or parent-resolution failure must emit route=full and block Verified even when full-route jobs pass.

Documentation gates (ADR/index/cross-reference, docs-index, README quickstart, CLI/MCP/env-registry drift, DCO identity, criteria vocabulary) must be extracted into a single shared composite action at .github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml and invoked by both full and docs-only routes without duplicating command lists.

All existing workflow-structure consumers (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_check_adr_numbers_heldout.py, test_check_config_reads_heldout.py, test_complexity_baseline.py, test_extra_coverage_guard.py, test_git_floor_gate_tree_skew.py, test_dependency_advisory_wiring.py, test_worktree_python_pin.py) must be preflight-migrated to follow extracted gates while preserving every assertion.

The classifier allowlist must fail-closed (defaulting to full route) for Python, shell, executables, workflows, actions, dependencies, locks, tests, fixtures, configuration, policy, unrecognized, empty, malformed, or unreadable paths; classifier and allowlist execute only from origin/main with credentials disabled and sparse checkout.

Documentation-only route results, classifier results, and full-route job results must all be present in vote.needs; exactly one route must execute; failed documentation gates or classifier failure must block Verified +1; the first genuine docs-only change (1786) proved 82.4% wall-clock and 93.9% runner-minute savings versus baseline (1778).
